payload.title: Bring HN reference router live after provider key correction
payload.description: The shared Cyclotron provider secret now holds the TypeSafe key. A live smoke attempt on 2026-10-21 (one item, router flipped live for one invocation, then restored to dry-run) was refused by Cyclotron with run_busy: command job bf25e156 on the standing run is claimed and running with no result, left by the earlier wrong-key attempt; its queue message is in the dead-letter queue. The worker refuses to reclaim it by design (running command requires scoped reconciliation). Router is in dry-run, 115 items waiting. Needs an owner-approved reconciliation of that one job before the bounded live pass, the live flip and the two-cycle watch.
